dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: It's said that the destruction of the city was not a deed done from without, but that it fell to revolt from within. That certainly lines up with what we've seen...

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: Most of the damage was done to the interior. Perhaps it was a slave revolt? Or a civil war between priests?

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: It could also be the work of long years of disrepair or Wenut activity, right?

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: Wenut...? I doubt that much at least. Wenut don't dare to touch these ruins, and if the elders are to be believed, that's because this city is "ill-fated."

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Alright, enough ghost stories for now. Let's keep going.
